body: Tested locally, it mostly works as expected. In terms of UX, I think this is a good stepping stone for full accelerator support (with buttons and popup options having underlined letters when you press Alt). Some feedback: - The first letter shortcut doesn't follow the current editor language as I'd expect it to. For example, switching to French, pressing Alt then A won't focus on *Aide* (Help): Pressing H will still focus *Aide* here. This occurs even after restarting the editor, so it's not related to switching languages during an editor session. Since the shortcut is based on visible text, I would expect it to match the current language. This would also make it behave closer to PopupMenu incremental search. - Pressing Alt again should act like Escape and unfocus the menu, similar to native Windows accelerators.
